---
title: "Blood correction"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true

execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
---

Blood in a biopsy dilutes the muscle proteins, so many proteins rise or fall with the blood index.
The comparisons carry the index as a covariate. Some later methods cannot: module building,
set scores and correlations. They read a copy of the protein values with each protein's blood
slope removed. This step builds that copy, after testing three ways to remove the slope.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: packages
#| message: false
library(here)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
source(here("00_Setup", "Shared_functions", "workbooks.R"))
inputs <- c(proteins = "01_Processing/02_Quantification/c_data/quantification.rds")
paths <- vapply(inputs, here, character(1))
stopifnot(file.exists(paths))
```

## Input

limpa's protein values: complete log2 values, a standard error for each, and per value the number
of observed precursors (`other$n.observations`). A value with no observed precursor was estimated
from the detection curve.

```{r}
#| label: input
proteins <- readRDS(paths[["proteins"]])
blood <- proteins$targets$blood
observed <- proteins$other$n.observations > 0
time_design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + timepoint, proteins$targets)
design <- cbind(time_design, blood = blood)
c(
  proteins = nrow(proteins), biopsies = ncol(proteins),
  pct_estimated = round(100 * mean(!observed), 1)
)
```

## Three ways to remove the slope

Each fits protein ~ time point + blood and subtracts the blood term, so time differences are kept.
They differ in which values the slope is fitted on and removed from:

- **a, all values**: `limma::removeBatchEffect()` fits and removes on every value, observed or
  estimated.
- **b, observed values only**: `lmFit()` with weight 1 on observed values and 0 on estimated ones,
  so the slope is fitted on observed values only, and it is removed from them; estimated values are
  left as limpa made them.
- **c, precision-weighted**: `lmFit()` with weights 1/SE², removed from every value.

```{r}
#| label: variants
variant_a <- removeBatchEffect(proteins$E, covariates = blood, design = time_design)
weighted <- lmFit(proteins$E, design, weights = 1 / proteins$other$standard.error^2)
variant_c <- proteins$E - outer(weighted$coefficients[, "blood"], blood)
observed_fit <- lmFit(proteins$E, design, weights = 1 * observed)
variant_b <- proteins$E - outer(observed_fit$coefficients[, "blood"], blood) * observed
```

## Which one works

A correction works if it lowers each protein's correlation with blood. The check is the median
absolute Spearman correlation with the blood index, by how many biopsies observed the protein.
The rule, set before looking: keep the variant that lowers it in every band.

```{r}
#| label: check
band <- cut(rowSums(observed), c(0, 20, 39, ncol(proteins)), labels = c("<=20", "21-39", ">=40"))
blood_rho <- \(values) abs(apply(values, 1, \(x) cor(x, blood, method = "spearman")))
check <- list(
  uncorrected = proteins$E, a_all_values = variant_a, b_observed_only = variant_b,
  c_precision_weighted = variant_c
) |>
  vapply(\(values) tapply(blood_rho(values), band, median), numeric(3)) |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "observed_in") |>
  mutate(n_proteins = as.vector(table(band)), .after = observed_in)
check
passes <- vapply(
  c("a_all_values", "b_observed_only", "c_precision_weighted"),
  \(v) all(check[[v]] < check$uncorrected), logical(1)
)
passes
stopifnot(passes[["b_observed_only"]])
```

Variants a and c raise the blood correlation of sparsely observed proteins: their slope is fitted
mostly on estimated values, which do not carry the protein's blood relationship, and subtracting it
adds blood signal. Variant b lowers the correlation in every band and is kept.

```{r}
#| label: fig-check
#| fig-cap: "Median |Spearman rho| with the blood index, by detection band and variant."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3
check |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-c(observed_in, n_proteins), names_to = "variant", values_to = "rho") |>
  ggplot(aes(observed_in, rho, colour = variant, group = variant)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "biopsies observed", y = "median |rho| with blood", colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: validate
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(variant_b), identical(dim(variant_b), dim(proteins$E)),
  all(variant_b[!observed] == proteins$E[!observed])
)
```

## Save

`blood_correction.rds` is the protein `EList` with `E` replaced by variant b; standard errors,
annotation and biopsy table are unchanged.

```{r}
#| label: save
corrected <- proteins
corrected$E <- variant_b
out <- here("01_Processing", "03_Blood_Correction", "c_data")
dir.create(out, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(corrected, file.path(out, "blood_correction.rds"))
write_workbook(
  list(blood_check = check),
  "Median |Spearman rho| with the blood index by detection band, uncorrected and three variants.",
  file.path(out, "blood_correction.xlsx"), inputs, paths
)
```
